I approved Case B-042. Every requirement in the procedure is met and no risk factor applies.

**Ownership and control (3.1–3.4)**
- The entity is not on the excluded list and is not a nonprofit, so all owners of 20% or more must be identified.
- Direct owners are Vera Castillo (26%), Chloe Gupta (32%), Farah Lindqvist (25%) and Juniper Holdings LLC (17%). That adds up to 100%, and the customer's certification gives the same figures.
- Juniper's owners are known: Goran Vargas (49%) and Hana Eriksen (51%). That gives each of them about 8–9% of the entity. Juniper's whole stake is only 17%, so no one could reach 20% through it.
- Ownership is complete. The three 20% owners have verified IDs, and so do Goran Vargas and Hana Eriksen.
- The control person is Vera Castillo, the Chief Executive Officer.

**Registry filing (3.5)**
- Filed 2026-02-22, about eight months before the 2026-10-27 review, so it is within the 12-month limit.

**Screening (4.1–4.4)**
- No sanctions match, no politically exposed person and no adverse media for the entity or any of the five individuals.
- One gap: the system gives only "no" for adverse media. It doesn't record the search terms, date or sources that section 4.4 asks to be recorded. I treated this as a record-keeping step, not a missing fact, so it didn't block approval. If you read 4.4 as making the search record a required fact, the result would be "incomplete" instead.

**Industry (5.1–5.3)**
- Normal industry, so neither the prohibited nor the restricted rules apply. The licence is marked unverified, but that only matters for money services businesses.

**Geography (6.1–6.2)**
- The entity and all individuals are in Germany. Germany is not comprehensively sanctioned and is not on the FATF high-risk or increased-monitoring lists. The individuals are US nationals.
